code: parsed_params = g_uri_parse_params ((const gchar *) data, (gssize) size, '&', FALSE);
note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are passed directly as the parameter string and length.
The parser derives the key span from the current input slice before decoding it.
The decoder reads two bytes past a trailing '%' without first proving that the slice still has three bytes available.
When the input ends with a lone '%', this out-of-bounds read triggers the heap-buffer-overflow reported by ASan.
